description: What should I reorder? Returns the tenant's reorder decision (the one its reorder and transfer sweeps propose with, and the item page shows) as actionable recommendations in three buckets: purchase orders (buy from vendor, grouped-ready via defaultSupplier), manufacturing orders (make internally: manufactured items and sub-assemblies), and transfers (move stock to a 3PL/FBA node, capped at what the source warehouse can give: transferSourceWarehouseName, transferSourceShortfall). Most-critical first. By default each warehouse is decided with the look-ahead of the sweep that proposes for it (the gap to its next run, or none before a sweep owns proposals), so the answer matches the item page and the inbox (matchesReorderDecision). Pass includeForecastProjection/horizonDays only for a what-if look further ahead: items ON TRACK to breach their reorder point within horizonDays. Each bucket is paged independently by limit + offset and reports its pre-paging Total, so recommendations past the first page are reachable on large tenants. Renders the Reorder Decision Board with available stock, days on hand, suggested quantities, and sourced purchase lead times. Days on hand is available ÷ the planning rate (forecast, sales history and production pulls), the same figure the item page and get_item_stock_outlook show. Call this directly for low-stock/reorder questions; do not open onboarding or readiness first. Missing data is shown in a collapsed improvement section, and unknown coverage stays null rather than zero. A purchase recommendation an open draft PO already carries names that draft (openDraftPurchaseOrderNumbers): a draft is not on order until it is issued, so review or issue it rather than drafting the item again. withoutReorderPoint lists items with demand that NO bucket can include because they have no reorder point (hasReorderPointRow=false: no reorder-point row at that warehouse; pinned=true: set at 0 and never recalculated; otherwise a calculated reorder point still at 0; madeInHouse=true: an item built from its own bill of materials, which the daily build sweep plans once it has a row; atTransferNode=true: a warehouse supplied by transfer, whose row the transfer sweep creates), lowest days on hand first. When totalWithoutReorderPoint > 0 the buckets are not the whole answer: say how many items are left out and why, name the most urgent, and offer to set their reorder policy (set_inventory_policy). discontinued lists positions of discontinued items: they still sell but are never reordered, so they are left out of every bucket on purpose; mention them only to explain why an item is not recommended (transfers to a node still move a discontinued item's existing stock).

horizonDays.description: What-if only: forecast look-ahead in days (turns on the projection). Omit to decide with the tenant's reorder look-ahead.

includeForecastProjection.description: What-if only. true flags items projected to breach their reorder point within horizonDays; false only items already below. Omit to decide with the tenant's reorder look-ahead.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset applied within each bucket for paging (default 0). Compare against the bucket's Total to know when the last page is reached.

supplierId.description: Optional vendor id (GUID). Keeps only purchase orders, and withoutReorderPoint items bought, whose default vendor it is. Manufacturing orders, transfers, and madeInHouse or atTransferNode items have no vendor, so they are listed whatever vendor is given.

warehouseId.description: Optional warehouse id (GUID) to scope the sweep.

name: get_reorder_recommendations

items.description: A position of a discontinued item: it still sells, but nothing buys or makes more of it, so no bucket lists it however low it runs.

currentAvailable.description: Available at the warehouse; null with no projection yet.

daysOnHand.description: Available ÷ the planning rate; null with no planning rate.

basis.description: How the item is decided: reorder_point (a purchased item against its reorder point), material_plan (a BOM component by days of supply) or manufactured_cover (a made item by days of supply against safety stock).

dailyVelocity.description: Days-based material demand rate in units/day. Omitted when unavailable; zero is a supplied value.

daysOfSupply.description: Days-based effective inventory coverage, including inbound supply. Omitted when unavailable; use daysOnHand for current shelf coverage.

daysOnHand.description: Days on hand: available ÷ the planning rate (dailyConsumption), the stockout-urgency signal. The same figure the item page and dashboard show. Null means no demand signal.

feedFreshness.description: External stock feed state that qualified the decision: Stale (proposed, but confirm on hand). Omitted for a fresh or internal warehouse.

inventoryPosition.description: On hand plus open purchase orders plus open transfers in (for a manufactured item, plus the output of its open manufacturing orders): the supply the trigger compares.

leadTimeDays.description: Lead time used by days-based detection. Omitted for other demand sources; use purchaseLeadTimeDays with purchaseLeadTimeSource for purchase timing. Zero is a supplied value.

lookAheadDays.description: Days of forecast demand the decision looked ahead: the gap until the sweep that proposes for this warehouse next runs. 0 when it decided on the position now.

openDraftPurchaseOrderNumbers.description: Purchase recommendations only: numbers of open draft POs (not yet issued) that already carry this item for this warehouse. Drafts are not counted as supply; review or issue them instead of drafting again. Omitted when there is none.

openDraftPurchaseOrderQuantity.description: Purchase recommendations only: total quantity those open drafts carry. Omitted when there is none.

purchaseLeadTimeDays.description: Effective purchase lead time in days. Zero can be valid. Use for order timing only with a recognized purchaseLeadTimeSource other than SystemFallback; otherwise confirm it first.

purchaseLeadTimeSource.description: Lead-time evidence: ManualOverride, HistoricalAverage, SupplierDefault, PriceBookEstimate, TransferTransit, or ManufacturingLeadTime. SystemFallback is an unconfirmed estimate. Missing or unknown sources also require confirmation before order timing.

suggestedQuantity.description: What to order, make or transfer: the decision's quantity. For a transfer, what its source can give.

transferSourceShortfall.description: Transfers only: the part of the reorder quantity the source cannot give, which suggestedQuantity leaves out. Omitted when the source covers it.

transferSourceWarehouseId.description: Transfers only: the warehouse the transfer draws from (the governing transfer rule's source, else the node's supply route).

transferSourceWarehouseName.description: Transfers only: the source warehouse's name.

atTransferNode.description: True when the warehouse is replenished by transfer from a source warehouse: a reorder point here proposes a transfer, not a purchase, and the transfer sweep creates its rows.

daysOnHand.description: Available ÷ the planning rate; null with no planning rate.

hasReorderPointRow.description: False when the item has no reorder-point row at this warehouse, so the reorder decision does not consider it there at all (materials included): the reorder sweep has not created one yet, or nothing will (a transfer node with no transfer sweep).

madeInHouse.description: True when the item is made in-house (its own bill of materials): it needs a build, not a purchase, and the daily build sweep creates its reorder-point row where it has demand.

pinned.description: True when the reorder point is pinned at 0, so it is never recalculated: set a reorder point or unpin it. False with hasReorderPointRow=true: a calculated reorder point still at 0; false with hasReorderPointRow=false: no reorder-point row.
